about: Ashtrom Group Ltd. operates as a construction and property company in Israel and internationally. The company also constructs various projects, comprising infrastructures and mega-projects, residential and public buildings, hotels, office blocks, retail, logistic and industrial facilities, industrial building plants, and groundwork and underground infrastructures, as well as educational, community, and security institutions.
